name: list_boards
description: List all boards with their ids, names and habit counts, and which one is active. Habit tools only work on the active board.

name: list_habits
description: List every habit on the active board with id, title, tags, description, placement (period or hour), position inside that placement, and today's done state. Returns confirmed data only; staged changes are not included.

name: add_habit
description: Stage a new habit on the active board. Give exactly one of period or hour. Use period unless the user states an exact hour. The result returns the new habit id.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags, e.g. "运动, 每天".

sourceExcerpt.description: Short quote from the user's source material that supports this habit, when it was extracted from text or images.

position.description: 0-based slot inside the target placement; omit to put it first.

name: update_habit
description: Stage edits to a habit's title, description or tags. Only the given fields change. Use move_habit to change its time.

name: move_habit
description: Stage moving a habit to another period or hour, or to another position in the same one. Give exactly one of period or hour.

position.description: 0-based slot inside the target placement; omit to put it last.

name: delete_habit
description: Stage deleting a habit. Only use when the user clearly asks to remove it.

name: set_habit_done
description: Stage checking or unchecking a habit as done today.

name: list_nodes
description: List every node of one ability map as a tree: id, name, level (0 = 领域, 1 = 能力组, 2 = 能力), parentId, order among siblings, and whether it has a note.

map.description: vision = Long-term Vision map, research = Research Agenda map.

name: read_node
description: Read the Markdown notes of one or more nodes in one call.

map.description: vision = Long-term Vision map, research = Research Agenda map.

ids.description: One or more ids; read everything you need in one call.

name: add_node
description: Stage a new node. Without parentId it becomes a top-level 领域 (level 0); under a level-0 node it is a 能力组; under a level-1 node it is a 能力. Level-2 nodes cannot have children. The result returns the new node id.

map.description: vision = Long-term Vision map, research = Research Agenda map.

name: update_node
description: Stage edits to a node's name, Markdown note, or color (color only applies to level-0 nodes).

map.description: vision = Long-term Vision map, research = Research Agenda map.

name: move_node
description: Stage moving a node (with its subtree) under another parent, or to the top level with parentId "". position is the 0-based slot among the new siblings; omit to put it last. The tree is at most three levels deep.

map.description: vision = Long-term Vision map, research = Research Agenda map.

parentId.description: Target parent id, or "" for the top level.

name: delete_node
description: Stage deleting a node together with all of its descendants. Only use when the user clearly asks to remove it.

map.description: vision = Long-term Vision map, research = Research Agenda map.

name: list_knowledge
description: List every knowledge record with id, title, hierarchical tags and next review time.

name: read_knowledge
description: Read one or more knowledge records in one call: Markdown body, source and recall points.

ids.description: One or more ids; read everything you need in one call.

name: list_due_reviews
description: List knowledge records that are due for review now, with their recall point prompts.

name: add_knowledge
description: Stage a new knowledge record. Keep the user's Markdown as the body; do not invent facts. Recall points are drafted later in the Recall panel. The result returns the new id.

tags.description: Hierarchical tag path separated by /, e.g. "社会学/组织理论".

name: update_knowledge
description: Stage edits to a knowledge record. Only the given fields change.

name: delete_knowledge
description: Stage deleting a knowledge record with its recall points and review history. Only use when the user clearly asks.

name: list_memories
description: List every memory's metadata: id, song, date, life stage, location, emotion and intensity (no body text).

name: read_memory
description: Read the body text of one or more memories in one call. The index already has every memory's metadata, so only read bodies you actually need.

ids.description: One or more ids; read everything you need in one call.

name: list_life_stages
description: List the user's life stages with start and end months (YYYY-MM).

name: add_memory
description: Stage a new memory. date is YYYYMMDD when the day is known, otherwise YYYYQn (e.g. 2021Q2). stage must be one of the life stage names or omitted. Keep the user's own words in content. The result returns the new id.

name: update_memory
description: Stage edits to a memory. Only the given fields change; stage "" clears it.

name: delete_memory
description: Stage deleting a memory. Only use when the user clearly asks.

name: list_diary
description: List the days of one month of the diary (id, heading and first line of each). The index already lists the current month; use this for other months.

name: read_diary
description: Read the full body of one or more diary days in one call.

items.description: A day id from the diary index: YYMMDD, or YYMMDD-2 for a second block with the same date.

days.description: Day ids; read everything you need in one call.

name: append_diary
description: Stage text added to a day's body: after the user's own writing, above the `=============================================【AI总结】=============================================` line when the day has one (in the 写日记总结 and 助推建议 tasks it goes under that line instead, which Beta Life handles). If the day does not exist yet it is created at the end of its month under the heading `## YYMMDD周X`. text is free-form Markdown (bullets, nested bullets indented with tabs, or paragraphs); do not include the `## ` heading.

name: rewrite_diary_day
description: Stage a full replacement of one existing day's body. text is everything under the day's `## YYMMDD周X` heading, without the heading. Read the day first and keep everything the user did not ask to change.

day.description: A day id from the diary index: YYMMDD, or YYMMDD-2 for a second block with the same date.

name: delete_diary_day
description: Stage deleting one whole day from the diary.

day.description: A day id from the diary index: YYMMDD, or YYMMDD-2 for a second block with the same date.

name: get_daily_summary
description: The digest of one day of the activity record: time per category (focus / neutral / slack / unclassified), the longest focus run, the top slack sites or apps, the longest unclassified apps or sites, time per board period, the per-day average of the previous 7 recorded days, and how many slack reminders bebe showed and how often the user went back to work. Durations are text like `1h 05m` or `6m 01s`. Only the last days the user allows in Settings can be read.

date.description: Local date YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today.

name: query_activity
description: Sum the activity record over a range of days, grouped by app, site (web pages by domain, other time by app), window title, or category; optionally only one category. For a single day (from = to) set sessions to also get each stretch with its local start and end time, e.g. to answer what the user was doing at 3 pm. If the user turned window titles off in Settings, titles are not returned and grouping by title fails.

sessions.description: Single day only: also list the sessions (at most 300).

name: snooze
description: Pause bebe's slack reminders, its questions about unclassified apps and its habit reminders for a while; one-off reminders still show. Give minutes from now, or until as local HH:MM (the next time that clock time comes, e.g. the sleep period start for 今晚). minutes 0 ends a pause now. Acts at once; the user can undo it.

name: schedule_reminder
description: bebe shows a one-off reminder bubble once, within the next 24 hours. Give minutes from now, or at as local HH:MM (the next time that clock time comes). For something every day, add a habit on the board instead. Acts at once; the user can undo it.

text.description: What to remind, short, in the user's words.

name: cancel_reminder
description: Cancel a one-off reminder by its id from the list of one-off reminders. Acts at once; the user can undo it.

name: offer_choices
description: Show 2–4 short options as buttons under your reply and end the turn; your reply text is the question. The option the user taps comes back as their next message. Use it when one short answer decides the request, e.g. whether a change is 只今晚 or 以后每天.

name: set_bebe_settings
description: Change bebe's lasting settings; staged for the user to confirm. Pass only the fields to change. quietHours replaces the whole list, so pass the existing quiet hours too when adding one, and [] to remove all.

slackWindowMinutes.description: Slack share is measured over this many recent minutes.

slackSharePercent.description: A slack reminder needs slack above this share of the window.

slackStreakMinutes.description: …and a current slack streak at least this long.

slackCooldownMinutes.description: At most one slack reminder this often.

slackSnoozeMinutes.description: How long 「再说」 on a slack reminder waits.

summaryLeadMinutes.description: The evening summary shows this long before the sleep period.

habitSnoozeMinutes.description: How long 「稍后提醒」 on a habit reminder waits.

habitLowPercent.description: A habit done on fewer than this percent of its recorded days in the last 7 gets a nudge suggestion at 0:00.

quietHours.description: No slack reminders, questions or habit reminders in these. end before start runs past midnight.

name: remember_preference
description: Remember something the user asked for, for good; staged for the user to confirm. style: how to talk, added to every conversation (e.g. 少用感叹号). about: a fact about the user's life or wishes (e.g. 周三下午要上课). One short line in the user's words.

name: forget_preference
description: Forget one remembered item; staged for the user to confirm. text must match the item exactly as listed.

name: classify_activity
description: Set how an app, a website or a window-title keyword counts on the timeline, for good; staged for the user to confirm. app: the app name as the timeline shows it; site: a domain like bilibili.com (covers its subdomains); keyword: words in window titles, checked before sites and apps. none removes the rule, so it becomes unclassified.
